title: Spudlight Upgrade — Conservation Ledger, Dissipation Bounds and Minimal Realizations
status: archive-generated mathematical contribution extending Spudlight/Starchforce; standard positive linear-systems results, not evidence for a new physical force
abstract: The Spudlight/Starchforce storage model gains a stronger conservation and systems-theory formulation. For a linear store, finite-horizon input must equal the sum of stock accumulation, useful release and loss. This produces exact release/loss fractions for an isolated charged store, positivity and stability conditions, a normalized one-pole bandwidth and a criterion for when additional hidden reservoirs are mathematically redundant. The value is an auditable ledger: any claimed hidden energy/material store must account for where input went, how much remains, how much was released and how much was dissipated. The same mathematics may be reused in non-energy domains only after stock and flux units are explicitly redefined.

model.parameters: eta>=0 and Gamma>=0 for the ordinary nonnegative stock interpretation

finite_horizon_balance.identity: K(T)-K(0)=integral_0^T J_in dt-integral_0^T J_out dt-integral_0^T J_loss dt
finite_horizon_balance.meaning: If an empirical physical application fails this balance beyond measurement uncertainty, the model or measurements are incomplete.
finite_horizon_balance.boundary: Call this energy conservation only when K and all fluxes are genuine energy quantities; otherwise it is a stock-flow balance.

isolated_store.meaning: The model partitions initial stock exactly between declared useful output and declared loss.

positivity_stability.positivity: K(0)>=0, J_in>=0, eta>=0, Gamma>=0 imply K(t)>=0
positivity_stability.stability: With zero input K=0 is exponentially stable when eta+Gamma>0.
positivity_stability.active_warning: Negative eta+Gamma implies isolated exponential growth and requires an explicit gain/source mechanism.

frequency_response.meaning: The same parameter combination controls time-domain relaxation and one-pole bandwidth; estimates should agree if the model is adequate.

minimal_realization.multi_store: dK/dt=A K+B u; y=C K+D u
minimal_realization.rule: Extra hidden reservoirs should correspond to reproducible additional poles/timescales and survive controllability, observability and model-selection checks.
minimal_realization.identifiability_warning: Different internal source/channel/store factorizations can produce the same input-output transfer function; mechanism requires intermediate measurements or constraints.

advancement_gates.ledger: Close the stock-flow ledger within uncertainty.
advancement_gates.timescale: Require a reproducible new pole/timescale before adding a store.
advancement_gates.mechanism: Do not interpret one fitted factorization as unique mechanism when equivalent realizations exist.
advancement_gates.cross_domain: Transfer the mathematics only after redefining domain-specific units and meanings.

failure_conditions: Finite-horizon balance does not close within uncertainty.
Transient and frequency-response estimates of the one-pole timescale conflict systematically.
Additional hidden stores are uncontrollable/unobservable or collapse under model reduction.
A passive storage equation is used to imply net physical amplification without an explicit source.
